# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest version on the `main` branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Use the
repository's [private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/ivo-gavran/ultra-next-template/security/advisories/new)
and include reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested mitigation.

You can expect an acknowledgement within five business days. Details should
remain private until a fix is available and a coordinated disclosure date has
been agreed.
